what: User frustrated: I claimed the README.md on aide-v0 and the public GitHub repo README were the same content, but they aren't. The public repo (aide-memory/aide-memory) got the unified README.npm.md content. But aide-v0/README.md still has the old content with stale framing ("What aide-memory closes that rules files don't", absolutes, etc.). The npm tarball shipped with aide-v0/README.md (the dev one), NOT README.npm.md. Must verify what actually shipped rather than assuming. Also: all external surfaces must use consistent language matching the website and blog posts.
